summary: [probe] With the list-item exemption gone, a terminated noun fragment in a list item is flagged as hortative again: '- 알림 받는 사람: 주최자, 참가자.', '- 검토 대상: 후보자.', '- 반품 사유: 단순 변심, 상품 하자.', '- 대회 순서: 선두 주자.' each draw prose.ko-ending ~자 (가자, 보자, 하자, 주자 in KO_HORTATIVE). Scenario 10 says noun fragments in list items (참가자, 하자, 보라) report nothing; the unit test dropped the period from '하자.' to keep passing, and the fixture's own '- 영수증 화면.' shows terminated fragments are meant to be exempt. Without the period they are exempt; '보라.' is no longer listed.
